summary: The project's reference Hack computer: single-cycle CPU (one instruction per clock), book ALU, two-RAM16K memory map. All other designs are measured against it.
limitations: Author of the original HDL is not recorded in the repository; comments credit Figure 5.9 of The Elements of Computing Systems.
Memory.hdl maps 0x0000-0x3FFF onto two RAM16K instances (each half used); behaviour matches the Hack memory map.
